test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A wooden piece in the shape of a cuboid is divided into five equal parts by cutting it with four cuts perpendicular to its length, and it turns out that each piece is a cube of volume 27 cm³. What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the cuboid?
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of each cube = 27 cm3

**Concept used:**

Volume of cube = a³

Total surface area of a cuboid = 2(l × b + b × h + l × h)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c4d7f25d09d990719ff29e43bc60cc1fcb6a2a6fd59744d619ff8cb4364209.png] 

Side of each cube (a) = 3

So, length of the cuboid = 5 × 3 = 15 cm

Height and breadth of the cuboid = 3 cm

Total surface area of the cuboid = 2(15 × 3 + 3 × 3 + 15 × 3)

⇒ 2 × 99 = 198 cm²

**∴ Total surface area of the cuboid is 198 cm2**
